tool.name: NVIDIA NemoClaw
tool.description: Open-source reference stack that runs always-on agents like OpenClaw inside NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes with policy and managed inference.
tool.statusNote: Alpha project per the README (checked 2026-09-30): maintainers respond on a best-effort basis; no tagged releases yet.
tool.practitionerNote: Useful for containing personal or always-on agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Deep Agents) with Balanced/Restricted/Open policy tiers, especially on DGX Spark or Linux/macOS/WSL hosts. Alpha status and no releases mean it is a pilot tool, not a production control.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Runs on operator hardware; inference goes local (Ollama/vLLM) or to a remote provider the operator selects.

deployment.detail: Self-hosted on DGX Spark/Station, Linux, macOS or Windows WSL.

auditLogging.detail: Audit logging is not described in the NemoClaw docs overview or README.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted OSS; SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted OSS; ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted OSS; ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Sandboxing runtime component, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.
